name: 36207 · Anniston, AL
findings: ZIP 36207 (Anniston) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36207 (Anniston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36207 (Anniston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
